answer: An oasis signs each identity only after a terrace records that operator's ocean as larger than the sum of all prior ocean. The first entry locks 1 ocean; the second must lock 2 ocean, the third 4, so k entries burn 2^k-1 ocean. The oasis will not open a fresh terrace for that operator until the last terrace ocean is forfeited, so the doubling cannot be restarted.
